Taxes — what you need to file.

    
Rough estimates only — not tax advice. You're a minor and your parents claim you as a dependent, so a parent should check this with a tax pro. Your dad doesn't have an accountant, so keep this page tidy — it's your whole paper trail.

    

    
Set-aside %   (same % as the Profit tab)

    
Filing checklist

    

    
Key facts (checked Nov 2026): if your net profit hits $400 in a year, you likely have to file a federal return and pay 15.3% self-employment tax — even as a dependent. Federal income tax is likely $0 while your total income is under the $16,100 standard deduction. No 1099-K is expected from Cash App / Greenlight at 30 pairs ($1,050 max) — that only kicks in over $20,000 AND 200+ transactions — but the income is taxable whether or not a form shows up. NY sales tax on the shorts is a separate question for a parent.

Accounts — everyone who signed up.

    
Owner only. Passwords are never shown here — and never stored where anyone can read them. When someone makes an account, Supabase scrambles their password into a one-way hash. Nobody can reverse it — not you, not me, not anyone with the database. That's what keeps people's accounts safe if the database ever leaks. If someone's locked out, send them a reset link and they'll pick a new password themselves.

    

    
To start recording accounts, run the new "Part 5 — clutch_accounts" block in supabase-tables.sql in the Supabase SQL Editor. Accounts made before that won't appear here (they're still in Supabase Auth → Authentication → Users, visible only to you in the dashboard).

The story

  
Built Different isn't a slogan.

  
I'm Sebastian. 7th grade, Upper East Side. I grew up on these blocks — the 6 train, the corner store, the courts after school. One day I wanted shorts that actually looked like where I'm from, so I mapped the whole neighborhood and put it on mesh.

  
Making them was the hard part. The first print came back with the map stretched out of shape. So the file got rebuilt from scratch — clean lines, straight grid, logo exactly where it belongs — until the print finally sat right.

  
Then the easy way to sell them fell apart. No Stripe, no normal checkout. Most people would've quit there. I rebuilt the whole drop around DMs and Greenlight instead. 30 pairs. One run. No restocks.

  
That's why the script on the inside of the pocket says "clutch built different (on the inside)." The outside is the map. The inside is everything it took to get here.

FAQ

  
Before you ask

  
When do preorders open?
Friday, November 27, 2026 at 6:00 PM ET — preorders open right here on this site.

  
What if I send the wrong amount?
Send the exact total shown at checkout. All sales are final once paid in full. If you send the wrong amount, your shorts will not ship — you can pay the rest to complete your order, or get a refund of what you sent. DM @clutchny1 either way. Double-check before you pay.


How do I buy a pair?
Tap “Checkout” above, pick your size, fill in your details — then it sends you to the Greenlight link to pay $35 total ($25 if you pick free NYC pickup). First paid, first served. You can also still DM @clutchny1 to buy.

  
Cash or card? Shipping?
$25 + shipping ($35 total), pay via Greenlight — or Cash App in the DM. We ship in the US with USPS Ground Advantage (about $8–$11, depends where you are) — or free local pickup in NYC. No holds without payment.

  
How much?
$25 a pair, plus shipping.

  
How many are there?
30 total: 10 Small, 10 Medium, 5 Large, 5 XL. When a size is gone, it's gone.

  
How does sizing run?
The waist runs small, so if you're between sizes, size up. Inseam is 5.5" measured flat.

  
Will there be a restock?
No. Drop 01 is never re-run.

  
Can I return or exchange?
All sales are final. Check the size chart before you buy.

  
How do I hear when preorders open?
Drop your email below, or follow @clutchny1 on Instagram.
